nodes.label: the doorway from the elevator hall
nodes.note: Fire doors held open between the elevator hall and the vestibule in front of Suite 301. Seen through it: an elevator door with a '3' floor plate and hall lantern on the left, a men's restroom and an electrical room door. Suite 301's double wood doors (Xfernet sign) are about 5 m ahead on the left. Whether that elevator is a passenger or a service car is not visible.

approach.note: the elevator hall is not scanned; an elevator door marked 3 is visible about 4 m past this doorway

nodes.label: the EXIT door beside the 301 sign
nodes.note: Inferred stair door: solid door at the east end of the corridor with a lit EXIT sign on the ceiling in front of it and a fire alarm pull station beside it. No stair sign is visible and the stairwell is not scanned; re-entry from the stair side may be locked.

approach.note: inferred from the EXIT sign over this door; the stairwell is not scanned

edges.note: Suite 301 (Xfernet) main entry: double wood doors with panic bars on the inside; card reader and intercom on the vestibule side. Propped open in part of the scan.

scope: 3rd floor only: Suite 301 (Xfernet offices and data hall), the vestibule outside its double doors, and about 50 m of the terrazzo corridor along the suite's south side. The elevator hall, the stairwells, the corridor west of the last sweep, the rooms behind the 'Protected Area' doors on the corridor's south side and the ramp beyond the data hall's west glass door are not scanned.
